s.note: Crisp Scottish oatcakes with sharp cheddar, sturdy enough for stone throwing.
s.how: Mix 200g oats with 50g melted butter, salt and a splash of hot water. Roll thin, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Serve with 200g sharp cheddar and apple chutney.

s.note: Smoked salmon squares, with Murron's thistle kept close.
s.how: Mash 50g soft butter with lemon zest. Spread on 6 slices wholemeal bread and top with 200g smoked salmon, dill and capers. Cut into neat squares.

m.note: Lamb neck simmered with barley, split peas, leeks, carrots and turnip.
m.how: Simmer 1kg lamb neck in 2.5L water with 100g pearl barley and 100g split peas for an hour. Add 2 leeks, 2 carrots and a diced swede and simmer another hour. Pull the meat back in and finish with parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Soft crowdie cheese whipped with heather honey, brambles and toasted oats.
w.how: Toast 60g rolled oats in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden, then cool. Beat 300g crowdie or ricotta with 3 tbsp heather honey until smooth. Layer into 4 glasses with 250g blackberries and the oats, finishing with a few berries and a drizzle of honey.

d.note: Honey mead warmed with clove and lemon peel, poured hot into cups.
d.how: Warm 750ml mead in a pan with 4 cloves and 2 strips of lemon peel until steaming, without boiling. Stir in 1 tbsp heather honey and pour into 4 heatproof cups. Leave out the mead and use cloudy apple juice for a hot spiced apple and honey.
